#!/bin/bash

cd /mnt/server || exit 1

echo "[JAGOAN PROJECT] Memulai instalasi..."

# Clone repository jika GIT_ADDRESS diisi
if [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo "[INFO] Cloning repository: ${GIT_ADDRESS}"
    if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
        git clone https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@${GIT_ADDRESS#https://} .
    else
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
else
    echo "[INFO] GIT_ADDRESS kosong. Mode upload manual - skip clone."
fi

# Install dependencies jika ada package.json
if [ -f package.json ]; then
    echo "[INFO] Menginstall dependencies..."
    npm install --production
    echo "[INFO] Dependencies berhasil diinstall!"
fi

echo "[JAGOAN PROJECT] Instalasi selesai!"
exit 0
